Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_LootRadius_: Largest distance, in squares, between the dead zombie and Scrappy for it to take the jewelry off the corpse. Same floor only.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_AuraMultipl: Electricity and Metal Welding XP the owner earns near a working Scrappy. 1.0 turns the aura off. Does not stack with skill books: the larger one wins.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_WorkingThre: Below this condition Scrappy stops picking jewelry and giving the XP aura. At 0% it breaks and stays put until repaired.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_WearPerKill: Condition Scrappy loses for every zombie it kills. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_WearPerDay_: Condition Scrappy loses per in-game day, even standing still. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ChargeBatte: How much of Scrappy's charge a full battery restores. A half-used one gives half. 0 = batteries do not recharge it.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ChargeCarBa: How much of Scrappy's charge a full car battery restores. 0 = car batteries do not recharge it.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_Electronics: Condition each electronics scrap restores at Electricity level 0.
Extra condition per Electricity level of the repairer.
XP per successful repair. The vanilla generator repair gives 5.
Below this level the repair starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ScrapMetalG: Condition each scrap metal restores at Metal Welding level 0.
Extra condition per Metal Welding level of the repairer.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ScrapMetalL: Scrap metal: required Metal Welding level (default 3)
Below this level the repair starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_CalibrateXP: XP per successful calibration. Calibrating spends 1 electronics scrap and needs no wear.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_CalibratePe: How many calibrations each Scrappy takes per in-game day. 0 turns calibrating off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_CalibrateLe: Below this level the calibration starts to fail (see the failure options).
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_FailBase_to: Chance to fail at exactly the required level. Same rule as the vanilla item repair.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_FailPerMiss: Added per level below the required one. With the defaults: level 0 = 93%, 1 = 63%, 2 = 33%, 3 = 3%.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_FailPerExtr: Taken off per level above the required one, down to 0%.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_FailedWear_: Condition Scrappy loses when a repair or calibration fails. The part is always lost and no XP is given.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_CycleTime_t: Duration of each repair or calibration cycle at level 0, in game action units (the generator repair uses 150).
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_CycleTimePe: How much the cycle shortens per level of the skill used.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ThreatAmber: From how many zombies near Scrappy (within the range dogs attack at) the eye and the light turn amber.
Sandbox_CompanionDogsScrappy_ThreatRed_t: From how many zombies near Scrappy (within the range dogs attack at) the eye and the light turn red.
